title: Fruit and vegetable products - Determination of mineral impurities content
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13816) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Fruit and vegetable products - Determination of mineral impurities content.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Method for Calibration of Horizontal and Tilted Oil Storage Tanks

clause_3_terminology: Fruit and vegetable products - Determination of mineral impurities content

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
